body.text: RAC is integrated into the RXB substructure. Two inlet and two outlet stacks stand on each of the north and south sides.

body.text: Stack outlets are higher than the inlets, which limits recirculation of air.

body.text: Inlet stacks terminate at least 30 feet above grade.

body.text: The collector cylinder is heated by thermal radiation from the GV outer surface. Air is heated by convection from the GV and collector cylinder.

body.text: When heat goes from the PHT to the IHT, the GV is cooler and RAC removes less heat.
